# ui-layout-inspector

> Right-side inspector panel within the layout, hidden by default and resizable.

**Class:** `UILayoutInspector`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the inspector panel is visible |

## Usage

```html
<ui-layout-inspector></ui-layout-inspector>
```
